decisions.reason: Significant DeFi exploit: attacker manipulated TONIC token price 100x in 20 minutes, used inflated collateral to borrow $74M. Only ~$6M in ETH extracted, rest stuck. Cronos halted and restarted chain. Tectonic TVL collapsed from $122M to ~$3M.

Novel threat intel: researcher's honeypot was discovered, relabeled as a popular model name, and used as a free LLM backend. A real coding-agent session hit it, exposing tool manifests and filesystem paths. Demonstrates supply-chain risk in free AI inference endpoints.
Routine WatchGuard vendor advisory (AV26-865) for Dimension and Fireware OS. No CVEs listed, no exploitation claims, standard patching guidance. Does not meet the quality bar for coverage.
